title: Human approval records
description: approvals/*.yaml. Written by a human, committed by a human. Claude must never create an approval record, fill in a reviewer name, or edit this file -- an LLM signing its own homework defeats the entire point of the gate. CI cross-checks every reviewer against the project.yaml roster and rejects unknown names.

reviewer.description: Name of the human. Must appear in project.yaml reviewers.

scope_commit.description: Commit hash of the design as reviewed. An approval does not carry forward across schematic changes: if the netlist changed, the approval is stale and the gate reverts to needing a fresh signature.

netlist_digest.description: Digest of the normalized netlist at approval time, so staleness is detected by connectivity change rather than by unrelated commits.

reviewed.description: What the human actually examined. Vague approvals are worth little in an audit.
